gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-jp: Sharp, tall and unmistakably techy, Oxanium holds one unbroken line through every curve while Noto Sans JP spreads out in a plain sans way. Its lowercase stands remarkably tall.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills each line with lowercase forms that stand nearly as tall as capitals, with an open channel in the e. Oxanium, meanwhile, draws its big lowercase in a single unbroken stroke, which suits the heading and leaves the body to do the quiet work.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada reads friendly and modern, with a gentle step up to capitals. Oxanium sketches big, distinctive letters with a pencil that never presses harder, while the body's open s curves handle the steady work underneath.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Oxanium draws a tube-like stroke that looks like neon glass, with a tall lowercase and curves ending in clear daylight, above a plain sans. Noto Sans Kayah Li stays quiet beneath it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, with curves that never close back on themselves. But Oxanium is the one with swagger, since its curves carry no stress at all and look distinctive at display size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has small letters standing proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous openings like a chisel notch in wood. Oxanium earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki reads clean and modern, with exits wide enough to pass light through and a large, clear eye on every e. Its plain sans friendliness sets off Oxanium's constant stroke width.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Marker-like and sharp up top, then friendlier below. Oxanium holds a constant-width line with a big lowercase, while Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals close to body height and its rounds unsealed, which is the strongest quality of the pair.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kr: Commanding up top, Oxanium draws a tube-like stroke like neon glass. Noto Sans KR follows with generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so a long passage would feel open and clean.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao pushes its x-height well above the usual, with mouths that stay open on c, e and a. Noto Sans Lao would read in a modern, spacious way over a long passage, while Oxanium holds its heading with no vertical emphasis.
